objective: Determine or bound sharply the exponential growth of the minimum fixed message for all later simultaneous ternary crossing tests on an arbitrary table of joint states.
status: Proved: For arbitrary correlated ternary-pair tables the minimum exact fixed-length advance message has exponential base six in the number of pairs. For product inputs there are exactly 1+109^b possible reports.
title: The growth of exact messages under simultaneous crossing tests
